app.name: era_seo
app.div:
ERA SEO Manager controls all SEO metadata emitted in your site's <head> — meta tags, Open Graph, Twitter cards, canonical URLs, JSON-LD schema scripts, site verification tokens, and more.
Fill in the sections below top to bottom. Every field has a help tooltip (hover the label) for guidance. After saving, open Website → SEO → Overview to verify the module has picked up your changes.

block.title: Organization Identity
block.div: These values appear in the Organization and LocalBusiness JSON-LD schemas that Google uses for Knowledge Panel entries. They also supply fallback values for Open Graph and Twitter cards.

setting.help: The public-facing name of your company. Shown in Organization and LocalBusiness schemas and used as the og:site_name fallback.
Full registered legal name of the company (may differ from the trading name). Included in the Organization schema's legalName field.

field.name: era_seo_default_legal_name
field.placeholder: e.g. Excellence Resources Arabia Co. Ltd.

setting.help: Absolute HTTPS URL to your organization logo (PNG or SVG, min 112×112 px). Used in the Organization schema logo field and as og:image fallback. Tip: upload the logo to Odoo attachments and copy the public URL.
Fallback Open Graph image (1200×630 px recommended) for pages that do not have a custom OG image set. Shown when someone shares any page on social media.
Your company's Twitter/X account. Must start with @. Used in twitter:site and twitter:creator meta tags. Example: @mycompany

block.title: Social Profiles
block.div: Enter the full URLs to your company's social media profiles. These are included in the Organization schema's sameAs array, which tells Google all the places this organization appears online — helping it build a more complete Knowledge Panel. Leave blank any platforms you do not use.

setting.help: Full URL to your Facebook page, e.g. https://facebook.com/mycompany
Full URL to your Twitter/X profile, e.g. https://twitter.com/mycompany
Full URL to your LinkedIn company page, e.g. https://linkedin.com/company/mycompany
Full URL to your Instagram profile, e.g. https://instagram.com/mycompany
Full URL to your YouTube channel, e.g. https://youtube.com/@mycompany

block.title: Site Verification
block.div:
Site verification tokens prove to search engine tools that you own this website. They are injected as <meta> tags in every page's <head>.
How to get your Google token: Go to Google Search Console → Add property → choose your domain → select "HTML tag" verification → copy only the content="…" value (not the full tag) and paste it below.
How to get your Bing token: Go to Bing Webmaster Tools → Add site → HTML Meta Tag → copy the content value.

setting.help: Paste only the content= value from the google-site-verification meta tag. Example: abc123XYZ. Do NOT paste the full <meta> tag.
Paste only the content= value from the msvalidate.01 meta tag provided by Bing Webmaster Tools.

block.title: JSON-LD Schema Engine
block.div:
When enabled, ERA SEO injects structured data (application/ld+json scripts) into every page that has schema instances attached. Go to Website → SEO → Schema Templates to browse the 17 built-in templates (Organization, WebSite, Article, Product, FAQ, Event…) and attach them to pages via the page's Schemas tab.
Validate output at
Google Rich Results Test .

setting.help: When disabled, no <script type=application/ld+json> tags are emitted anywhere on the site. Useful to temporarily suspend schema output without deleting instances.
